newsitem.title: UK: European cotton prices little moved in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: European cotton prices little moved in quiet trade.

text.p: Raw cotton prices in Europe followed New York futures prices to be quoted lower to unchanged in extremely thin trade, industry sources said.
With most mills closed for the holiday period, the likely impact of China's plans to cut back its cotton production in 1997 was impossible to gauge.
There were just two reports of small purchases for prompt delivery but trade is set to remain very quiet until the end of the holiday period.
